correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of W=z−g x²/(2a) gives dW/dt=−bW+κx² because the mixed gxy cancels the x′ term. Exact independent SymPy polynomial expansion checked the identity. A bounded complete trajectory makes W bounded; variation of constants from t−T to t and b>0 eliminates e^(−bT)W(t−T), yielding the nonnegative backward convolution. Equality at any t implies x vanishes on its entire past, then the first equation forces y=0; the third reduces to z′=−bz and backward boundedness forces z=0. Autonomous uniqueness makes the trajectory identically zero. Every compact invariant point belongs to a bounded complete orbit, proving the set statement. No unsupported assertion of existence of chaotic or other non-equilibrium recurrence.
risks: Without bounded two-sided completeness the backward memory is not justified; κ=0 loses strictness and κ<0 reverses the sign.

value.rationale: Exact pointwise parabolic confinement on every bounded complete non-equilibrium trajectory is more informative than a stationary moment balance, and is uniform in the arbitrary y-equation coefficients c,d. final_claim: For a>0, b>0, f,g≥0, f+g>0 and κ=f+g−bg/(2a)>0 in the Li–Zhao–Geng Lorenz-like flow, every bounded two-sided complete non-equilibrium orbit has z(t)>g x(t)²/(2a) for every time, with exact backward memory W(t)=κ∫₀^∞ exp(−bs)x(t−s)² ds; the same necessary strict confinement holds on all non-origin points of compact invariant sets.
